events.title: Log Drop Demo Update v0.1.5
events.summary: I've been blown away by how many people are enjoying the Log Drop demo, its been a wild past week since the demo came out, with over 25,000 people having played, and somehow reaching 600 peak concurrent users :oThanks to everyone engaging and leaving feedback across the various channels - I try to answer as much as i can! events.title: Log Drop Demo is Live!
